proof:
Source: steps 4–6 (hypotheses (α) and (β), with the scaling facts of step 5(ii),(iii)) of the parent-supplied proof of idtp_cse_flux_density_eq. ψ' := deriv ψ.
0. (Bounded test functions.) If g : ℝ → ℝ is continuous and tsupport g ⊆ (u, v), then tsupport g is closed and contained in the compact interval [u, v], hence compact (IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset), i.e. g has compact support, and a continuous function with compact support is bounded (Continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support). If moreover ψ is C¹ with tsupport ψ ⊆ (u, v), then ψ' is continuous (ContDiff.continuous_deriv with 1 ≤ 1) and has compact support (HasCompactSupport.deriv), hence is bounded. Consequently, for ψ, l as in (α) resp. (β) and r ≠ 0, the functions p ↦ ψ'(p_2)l(p_1), p ↦ l(p_1/r)ψ(p_2) and p ↦ l(p_1)ψ(p_2) on ℝ² are continuous, hence Borel, and bounded by the product of the bounds of their factors.
1. ((α).) Let ψ, l be as in (α) and b(p) := ψ'(p_2)l(p_1). By step 0 and (SI), ∫ ψ'(p_2)l(p_1)H(p) dp = ∫ b(p)H(p) dp = ∫_Z b(|x|, f(x))G(x) dμ(x) = ∫_Z ψ'(f(x))l(|x|)G(x) dμ(x), which is 0 by (RC).
2. (Setup for (β).) Fix l, ψ, r as in (β). From |r − 1| < s/4 ≤ 1/16 we get r > 0. Let Z' := {y : ⟨y,a⟩ > 0, |f(y)| < s, |y − πy| < s|y|}; Z' is Borel (strict inequalities between Borel functions: x ↦ ⟨x,a⟩, |f|, |x − πx| and s|x|, with f Borel as arctan of a quotient of continuous functions) and Z ⊆ Z'. Put h_1(x) := l(|x|/r)ψ(f(x))G(x) and h_2(x) := l(|x|)ψ(f(x))G(x). Applying (SI) to the bounded continuous functions b_1(p) := l(p_1/r)ψ(p_2) and b_2(p) := l(p_1)ψ(p_2) (step 0):
   (2.1) ∫ l(p_1/r)ψ(p_2)H(p) dp = ∫_Z h_1 dμ and ∫ l(p_1)ψ(p_2)H(p) dp = ∫_Z h_2 dμ.
3. (Radial windows.) (a) If x ∈ Z' and h_1(x) ≠ 0, then l(|x|/r) ≠ 0, so |x|/r ∈ support l ⊆ tsupport l ⊆ (1 − s/2, 1 + s/2) and |x| = r·(|x|/r) ∈ (r(1 − s/2), r(1 + s/2)). Since 1 − s/4 < r < 1 + s/4 and 0 < s ≤ 1/4: r(1 − s/2) > (1 − s/4)(1 − s/2) = 1 − 3s/4 + s²/8 > 1 − s, and r(1 + s/2) < (1 + s/4)(1 + s/2) = 1 + 3s/4 + s²/8 < 1 + s (as s²/8 < s/4). Thus ||x| − 1| < s and x ∈ Z. (b) If x ∈ Z' and h_2(x) ≠ 0, then |x| ∈ (1 − s/2, 1 + s/2), so ||x| − 1| < s/2 < s and x ∈ Z. Hence each h_i vanishes on Z' ∖ Z; since Z' is Borel and Z ⊆ Z', setIntegral_eq_of_subset_of_forall_sdiff_eq_zero gives ∫_{Z'} h_i dμ = ∫_Z h_i dμ, and integral_indicator gives ∫_{Z'} h_i dμ = ∫ 1_{Z'}h_i dμ (i = 1, 2). These identities of Bochner integrals need no integrability.
4. (Dilation invariance.) Let y ∈ ℝ^P. (i) |ry| = r|y|, so |ry|/r = |y| (norm_smul, r > 0). (ii) ⟨ry,e⟩/⟨ry,a⟩ = (r⟨y,e⟩)/(r⟨y,a⟩) = ⟨y,e⟩/⟨y,a⟩ (mul_div_mul_left with r ≠ 0; valid also when ⟨y,a⟩ = 0), so f(ry) = f(y). (iii) ⟨ry,a⟩ = r⟨y,a⟩ > 0 iff ⟨y,a⟩ > 0, and ry − π(ry) = r(y − πy), so |ry − π(ry)| < s|ry| iff r|y − πy| < rs|y| iff |y − πy| < s|y|; with (ii), ry ∈ Z' iff y ∈ Z'. (iv) A(ry) = rAy and π(ry) = rπy by linearity; hence if T_{ry} = T_y then |p_{T_{ry}}(A(ry))|² = r²|p_{T_y}(Ay)|² and |π(ry)|² = r²|πy|², so G(ry) = G(y) (mul_div_mul_left with r² ≠ 0; valid also when πy = 0). By (TS) applied to this r, T_{ry} = T_y for μ-a.e. y. Therefore, with φ := 1_{Z'}h_1, for μ-a.e. y: φ(ry) = 1_{Z'}(y)·l(|y|)ψ(f(y))G(y) = (1_{Z'}h_2)(y) (if y ∉ Z', both sides are 0 by (iii)).
5. (Scaling of μ.) By the sibling cone_integral (Submission.idtp_cse_fd_cone_integral_smul with n = 2, valid for every function), ∫ φ(ry) dμ(y) = (r²)^{−1} ∫ φ dμ; by step 4 and integral_congr_ae the left side equals ∫ 1_{Z'}h_2 dμ. Hence ∫ 1_{Z'}h_1 dμ = r² ∫ 1_{Z'}h_2 dμ (r² ≠ 0).
6. ((β).) By (2.1), step 3 and step 5: ∫ l(p_1/r)ψ(p_2)H(p) dp = ∫_Z h_1 dμ = ∫ 1_{Z'}h_1 dμ = r² ∫ 1_{Z'}h_2 dμ = r² ∫_Z h_2 dμ = r² ∫ l(p_1)ψ(p_2)H(p) dp. ∎

(β): for |r − 1| < s/4 both radial windows lie in (1 − s, 1 + s), so the Z-integrals equal integrals over the dilation-invariant sector Z'.
|ry|/r = |y|, f(ry) = f(y), 1_{Z'}(ry) = 1_{Z'}(y), and G(ry) = G(y) μ-a.e. by (TS); the sibling cone_integral then gives ∫1_{Z'}h_1 dμ = r²∫1_{Z'}h_2 dμ.
